segments.comment: insight.c enlightenment() copies plname into the window title and capitalizes its first byte with highc(). The nethackrc name is 32 UTF-8 bytes; options.c nmcpy() keeps 31, so plname ends with the lead byte of the final two-byte letter, and it starts with a two-byte letter, which highc() leaves alone. Ctrl-X in normal play shows the title. Seed, clock and name were chosen before any recording.
